name: Danganronpa: High Expectations
source:
Originally flown out with sixteen other Ultimates, people who are the best at what they do, Avery Morton ends up stuck in Destiny Airport as they learn that in order to leave... You have to kill and get away with it.

[From [url=https://mobiusei.itch.io/danganronpa-high-expectations]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾弗里·莫顿最初与其他十六名最擅长的终极战士一起飞行，最终被困在命运机场，因为他们了解到，为了离开……你必须杀人并逃脱惩罚。

[来自[url=https://mobiusei.itch.io/danganronpa-high-expectations]itch.io[/url]]
